# BRD

**Unity Games : Business Requirements Document** 

*Multi-doctype normalised architecture. Web form on Game Entry.*

| Field | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Author | Aman Kumar |
| Date | 15 May 2026 |
| Status | Draft for Nikhil and Sankar review |

# **1\. Overview**

Unity Games is a sports-registration application dependent on Frappe \+ ERPNext \+ Education \+ payments \+ Edu Quality. Parents fill ONE Frappe Web Form to register their child for an inter-school event (CBSE, ZP, Subroto, etc.). The form drives cascading dropdowns through ten normalised doctypes that map **organiser → game → age group → events**. Payments are handled by Frappe's \`payments\` app (configurable on the web form). Authentication uses a token-based auto-login link sent to the guardian. External-portal sync (CBSE) is handled later by a Playwright RPA.

# **2\. Architecture**

![4-layer architecture diagram][image1]

Four layers: masters (lookups), composite (Games — what is offered), season (Game Authority — what is running), registration (Game Entry — what the parent submits).

### **3.9.1 Multi-game fan-out — one submission → N records (technical note)**

The Web Form is bound to the Game Entry doctype, but a single submission can carry multiple games (the parent's selections accumulate in game\_entry\_details). One submission must therefore produce N separate Game Entry records — one per game. How that fan-out is done:

ONE Web Form submission   (game\_entry\_details \= N rows)  
        │  
        │  Game Entry controller — on\_submit  
        │  (whole block wrapped in ONE DB transaction)  
        ▼  
  for each row in game\_entry\_details:  
     • resolve \+ validate student Program Enrollment  
     • validate age\_group vs DOB and the Games rules  
     • check uniqueness  
         (game\_authority, student, name\_of\_game, academic\_year)  
     • create ONE Game Entry record for that game  
         (its own game\_entry\_details \= that single game,  
          stored read-only as the snapshot)  
        │  
        ▼  
  N rows  ⇒  N Game Entry records  
  All-or-nothing: any row fails  ⇒  whole submission  
  rolled back (no partial registrations).

### **Recommended solution**

• Keep the Web Form on Game Entry (as agreed). game\_entry\_details is the in-form multi-game selection cart.

• A controller hook (on\_submit / after\_insert) iterates game\_entry\_details and creates one Game Entry per game inside a single DB transaction. Each created record carries its own single-game, read-only game\_entry\_details snapshot.

• Atomicity: if any game fails validation or the uniqueness check, the entire submission is rejected — no partial registrations.

• Payment: a computed total\_entry\_fee (sum of the selected games' fees) is the field the Web Form Payments tab charges via amount\_field. The parent pays ONCE; on\_payment\_authorized then marks every spawned Game Entry as Paid.

### **Alternatives considered**

• A — Override the Web Form accept method. The payments app already overrides frappe.website.doctype.web\_form.web\_form.accept; we would have to chain ours after it. Works, but couples us to the payments-app override order and is harder to test.

• B — Bind the Web Form to a lightweight, non-submittable "Game Entry Request" cart doctype that fans out into Game Entry on submit. Cleanest separation, but adds a doctype and diverges from the agreed "web form on Game Entry" model.

• Decision: use the Recommended approach (controller-hook fan-out). Fall back to Alternative A only if payment-override ordering proves fragile during testing.

# **6\. Parent Flow**

![Parent flow swimlane diagram][image4]

• 1\. Receive Frappe Notice with auto-login link (one link per guardian).

• 2\. Click link → auto-signed in as guardian → lands on /unity-games.

• 3\. Pick child from dropdown → student fields prefill, PE resolves.

• 4\. Pick Game Authority. Then ADD ONE OR MORE GAMES in one go — for each game pick Name of Game → Age Group → Events (filters cascade). Selected games accumulate in a list before submitting.

• 5\. Tick consent → Submit ONCE. The server fans out and creates a SEPARATE Game Entry record per selected game, each validated against the student's Program Enrollment. If total fee \> 0, parent pays once; on success all created entries are marked Paid.

Multiple games are selected together in a single submission — no need to repeat the form per game. To register a different child, the same reusable auto-login link can be reopened any time.

# **7\. Coordinator Flow**

![Coordinator flow swimlane diagram][image5]

• 1\. Configure masters once: Game Organiser, Age, Game Events. Rarely changes.

• 2\. Configure Games per (organiser, name\_of\_game) — pick its age groups \+ events.

• 3\. Per cycle, create a Game Authority (e.g. CBSE Cluster Aug 2026\) and pick which Games are in scope.

• 4\. Publish the Web Form. Send Notice with the auto-login link to eligible guardians.

• 5\. Review incoming Game Entry rows → mark Shortlisted → Selected → push to external portal via RPA (Playwright).

# **8\. Authentication — Auto-Login Link**

Guardians receive a unique URL that auto-logs them in and lands them directly on the Web Form — no OTP, no password. Modelled on Walnut's existing pattern at edu\_quality/common/utils/auth.py:5-32 (used today by Student Applicant, Event Participant, CBSE LOC, and Refund Request) and on the CRM Invitation pattern at crm/crm/api/\_\_init\_\_.py:81-98.

## **The flow**

  Coordinator publishes a Game Authority (e.g. CBSE Cluster Aug 2026\)  
       │  
       │  Frappe Notice rendered with {{ guardian.form\_hash }}  
       ▼  
  Guardian receives Notice / Email / WhatsApp with a unique link  
       │  
       │  Clicks the link  
       ▼  
  GET /api/method/edu\_quality.api.unity.login\_as\_guardian  
       ?h=\<form\_hash\>\&redirect\_to=unity-games  
       │  
       │  1\. Look up Guardian by form\_hash  
       │  2\. Resolve linked User  
       │  3\. frappe.local.login\_manager.login\_as(user)  
       │  4\. set session cookies, 302 → /unity-games  
       ▼  
  Web Form loads.  frappe.session.user \= guardian.  
  Client Script calls get\_my\_students → populates Pick Student dropdown  
  with that guardian's children only.

# **1\. Executive Summary**

Unity Games digitises student participation in inter-school sporting events (CBSE, ZP, Subroto, district, Walnut-internal) as a standalone Frappe app dependent on Frappe, ERPNext, Education, payments, and Edu Quality. Parents register their child(ren) through a single authenticated Web Form whose dropdowns cascade through a normalised, ten-doctype data model: organiser → game → age group → events. A parent may select multiple games in one submission; the server fans these out into one Game Entry record per game, each validated against the student's Program Enrollment.

Authentication uses a token-based auto-login link (no OTP/password) modelled on Walnut's existing Student Applicant / CRM Invitation patterns. Payments reuse Frappe's \`payments\` app (a configurable Payments tab on the Web Form — no bespoke payment code). Selected registrations are later pushed to the external portal (cbseit.in) by a Playwright RPA, with a CSV-export fallback.

The design is fully configurable: new games, age groups, events, organisers, and tournament seasons are data records — no schema change or code deploy is required to onboard a new tournament body.

# **2\. Problem Statement & Background**

## **2.1 Current state**

• Coordinators circulate \~70 paper/WhatsApp forms per season; each game asks for different data.

• Parent responses are collected ad-hoc; data is re-keyed into cbseit.in manually.

• Selection (who represents Walnut) is tribal knowledge with no ERP record.

• No audit trail; no analytics by class/division/age; deadline misses incur ₹500–1000 CBSE late fees.

## **2.2 Problem**

Walnut has no canonical, auditable, configurable system of record for sporting participation that scales across organisers and academic years.

## **2.3 Background**

• Iterated across meetings (May 2026\) with Nikhil, Snehal, Ashwini, Badal.

• Single-vast-doctype approach was rejected as un-scalable. A normalised 10-doctype model was finalized.

• Nikhil's directive: use framework primitives (Frappe Web Form, payments app) — minimum bespoke code.

# **3\. Goals & Scope**

## **3.1 Goals**

• G1 — One authenticated Web Form for parents to register across all organisers \+ events.

• G2 — Configuration-driven: new game/organiser/season \= data, not code.

• G3 — One submission, multiple games; one immutable Game Entry per game.

• G4 — 100% audit trail (Frappe Version \+ submittable docstatus).

• G5 — Reuse existing edu\_quality infra: auth pattern, payments app, PE resolution.

## **3.2 In scope**

• All 10 doctypes; Web Form \+ Client Script; auth link; payment config; PE resolution; multi-game fan-out; selection workflow; RPA push (Phase 2); CSV fallback.

## **3.3 Out of scope (this release)**

• Live scoring / brackets / eliminations.

• Certificate generation & distribution.

• Photo-recognition tagging.

• CBSE late-fee auto-calculation (flat entry\_fee only — see Open Questions).

# **6\. Server-Side Implementation**

## **6.1 Game Entry — autoname()**

Builds a slugified composite name; uniqueness is enforced by Frappe (document names must be unique), covering (game\_authority, student, name\_of\_game, academic\_year).

def autoname(self):  
    slug \= lambda s: re.sub(r'\[^A-Za-z0-9\]+','-', (s or '').strip()).strip('-')  
    self.name \= '-'.join(\[  
        slug(self.game\_authority), slug(self.student),  
        slug(self.name\_of\_game),  slug(self.academic\_year)\])

## **6.2 Program Enrollment resolution \+ validate()**

Runs in before\_validate / validate. Authoritative — the Web Form never trusts client-set values for these.

def resolve\_pe(self):  
    ay \= self.academic\_year or frappe.defaults.get\_global\_default('academic\_year')  
    pe \= frappe.db.get\_value('Program Enrollment',  
         {'student': self.student, 'academic\_year': ay, 'docstatus': 1}, 'name')  
    if not pe:  
        frappe.throw(\_('No active Program Enrollment for {0} in {1}. '  
                       'Contact school admin.').format(self.student, ay))  
    self.program\_enrollment \= pe  
    pe\_doc \= frappe.get\_cached\_doc('Program Enrollment', pe)  
    self.academic\_year   \= pe\_doc.academic\_year  
    self.student\_class   \= pe\_doc.program  
    self.student\_division= pe\_doc.student\_batch\_name  
    st \= frappe.get\_cached\_doc('Student', self.student)  
    self.date\_of\_birth \= st.date\_of\_birth  
    self.student\_age   \= age\_on(self.date\_of\_birth)  \# today − DOB

***Table 6.1: Game Entry validate() rule set***

| \# | Rule | Action on failure |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| V1 | Active PE exists for (student, AY) | throw — block submit |
| V2 | name\_of\_game ∈ game\_authority.games\[\*\].game | throw — invalid cascade |
| V3 | age\_group ∈ Games(name\_of\_game).age\_groups\[\*\].age | throw — invalid age for game |
| V4 | events ∈ Games(name\_of\_game).events\[\*\].game\_event | throw — invalid event for game |
| V5 | age-as-on-31-Dec(DOB) consistent with age\_group band | throw / warn (see OQ) |
| V6 | Game Authority.status \= Published and enabled | throw — registration not open |
| V7 | today ∈ \[start\_date, end\_date\] | throw — window closed |
| V8 | Unique (game\_authority, student, name\_of\_game, academic\_year) | throw — duplicate |
| V9 | Consent ticked | throw — consent required |

## **6.3 Multi-game fan-out**

The Web Form is bound to Game Entry, but one submission can carry N games in game\_entry\_details. The controller fans these into N separate Game Entry records inside a single transaction.

ONE submission (game\_entry\_details \= N rows)  
   │  on\_submit  (single DB transaction)  
   ▼  
 for row in game\_entry\_details:  
   • resolve \+ validate PE (6.2)  
   • validate cascade \+ age \+ uniqueness (V2–V8)  
   • create ONE Game Entry for that game; its own  
     game\_entry\_details \= that single row (RO snapshot)  
 N rows ⇒ N Game Entry records.  
 Any row fails ⇒ whole submission rolled back (atomic).

### **Recommended approach**

• Keep Web Form on Game Entry. game\_entry\_details is the in-form cart.

• Controller hook (on\_submit / after\_insert) iterates rows, creates one Game Entry per game in one transaction.

• total\_entry\_fee \= Σ per-game fees → the Payments-tab amount\_field; parent pays once; on\_payment\_authorized marks every spawned record Paid.

### **Alternatives**

• A — Override Web Form accept (payments app already overrides it; we chain). Works but couples to override order.

• B — Bind Web Form to a non-submittable "Game Entry Request" cart that fans out. Cleanest separation; adds a doctype; diverges from agreed model.

• Decision: Recommended approach; fall back to A only if payment-override ordering proves fragile.

# **8\. Authentication — Auto-Login Link**

Guardians receive a unique URL that auto-logs them in (no OTP/password) and lands them on the Web Form. Modelled on edu\_quality/common/utils/auth.py:5-32 (Student Applicant, Event Participant, CBSE LOC, Refund Request) and crm/crm/api/\_\_init\_\_.py:81-98 (CRM Invitation).

## **8.1 Flow**

 Coordinator publishes a Game Authority  
    │ Frappe Notice rendered with {{ guardian.form\_hash }}  
    ▼  
 Guardian clicks link →  
  GET /api/method/unity\_games.api.login\_as\_guardian  
       ?h=\<form\_hash\>\&redirect\_to=unity-games  
    │ 1\. lookup Guardian by form\_hash  
    │ 2\. resolve linked User  
    │ 3\. frappe.local.login\_manager.login\_as(user)  
    │ 4\. set cookies, 302 → /unity-games  
    ▼  
 Web Form loads; session.user \= guardian.  
 Client Script → get\_my\_students() → Pick Student dropdown

## **8.2 Artifacts**

***Table 8.1: Authentication artifacts***

| Artifact | Where | Purpose |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Custom Field form\_hash | Guardian doctype (owned by education app); CF shipped by unity\_games as a fixture; Data, unique, 20-char | Per-guardian token |
| after\_insert hook | unity\_games/unity\_games/overrides/guardian.py | frappe.generate\_hash(name, 20\) |
| login\_as\_guardian | unity\_games/api.py (allow\_guest=True) | Validate hash → login\_as → 302 |
| get\_my\_students | unity\_games/api.py | Guardian's children for the dropdown |
| Backfill patch | unity\_games/patches/populate\_guardian\_form\_hash.py | Hashes for existing guardians |
| Notice template | Frappe Notice / Email / WhatsApp | Delivers the link |

## **8.3 Endpoint**

@frappe.whitelist(allow\_guest=True)  
def login\_as\_guardian(h, redirect\_to='unity-games'):  
    g \= frappe.db.get\_value('Guardian', {'form\_hash': h}, \['name','user'\], as\_dict=1)  
    if not g:        frappe.throw(\_('Invalid or expired link'))  
    if not g.user:   frappe.throw(\_('No user linked to this guardian'))  
    frappe.local.login\_manager.login\_as(g.user)  
    frappe.local.response\['type'\] \= 'redirect'  
    frappe.local.response\['location'\] \= '/' \+ redirect\_to

## **8.4 Security**

• 20-char token (\~120 bits entropy) — not guessable.

• Reusable, no expiry; rotate Guardian.form\_hash to invalidate.

• Defence in depth: permission\_query\_conditions on Game Entry restricts reads to the guardian's own children even with a valid hash.

• Every login\_as is recorded in Frappe Login Activity.

# **9\. Payment Integration**

No bespoke payment component. Frappe's \`payments\` app supplies a configurable Payments tab on the Web Form (see 7.2). If total\_entry\_fee \> 0, Frappe redirects to the gateway after the submission is created; on success it calls on\_payment\_authorized().

 Submit (total\_entry\_fee \> 0\)  
   │ Web Form accept (payments override) inserts Game Entry/-ies  
   │ get\_payment\_gateway\_url reads total\_entry\_fee  
   ▼ 302 → Easebuzz / GrayQuest hosted page  
 Parent pays → gateway webhook → Integration Request Completed  
   │ Frappe calls Game Entry.on\_payment\_authorized()  
   ▼ payment\_status='Paid' on all spawned entries; notify

• NEW code: on\_payment\_authorized() (\~5 lines) \+ total\_entry\_fee compute.

• REUSED: payments app accept override, gateway accounts, webhook chain — unchanged.

• Free events (total\_entry\_fee \= 0): payment skipped entirely.

• CBSE late fees (₹500–1000): deferred — see Open Questions.

DO NOT reimplement — just configure. |

# **10\. Workflows**

## **10.1 Coordinator setup workflow**

• 1\. Seed masters (once / per AY): Game Organiser, Age, Game Events.

• 2\. Build Games rows per (organiser, game) with their age\_groups \+ events child rows. (CBSE: import from Annexure-A as fixtures.)

• 3\. Per season, create a Game Authority (e.g. CBSE Cluster Aug 2026); add the in-scope Games; set window dates; Publish.

• 4\. Publish the Web Form; send Frappe Notice with the per-guardian auto-login link.

• 5\. Monitor Game Entry list; mark Shortlisted → Selected; trigger RPA sync; CSV fallback.

## **10.2 Parent registration workflow**

• 1\. Receive Notice with auto-login link.

• 2\. Click → auto-signed in → /unity-games.

• 3\. Pick child → student fields prefill; PE resolves (server).

• 4\. Pick Game Authority → add one or more games (Name of Game → Age Group → Events → Add to list).

• 5\. Tick consent → Submit once.

• 6\. Server fans out → one Game Entry per game (validated vs PE).

• 7\. If total\_entry\_fee \> 0 → pay once at gateway → all entries marked Paid.

• 8\. WhatsApp \+ email confirmation listing all registrations.

## **10.3 Selection workflow**

• Coordinator filters Game Entry by game\_authority \+ name\_of\_game \+ age\_group.

• Bulk-set selection\_status: Applied → Shortlisted → Selected (or Rejected). All transitions logged via Frappe Version.

• Reversals supported and logged.

## **10.4 External portal sync (RPA — Phase 2\)**

• Filter Selected \+ external\_sync\_status \= Not Synced.

• Playwright logs into cbseit.in as Walnut; per student fills 3 dropdowns (Game, Age Group, Event); Save; capture UID.

• Write external\_portal\_uid \+ external\_sync\_status back. Failures retryable.

• CSV export always available as fallback if RPA breaks mid-cycle.

# **12\. Edge Cases & Validation Matrix**

***Table 12.1: Edge-case handling***

| Case | Handling |
| :---- | :---- |
| No active PE for (student, AY) | throw; block submit; message to contact admin |
| Two active PEs same AY | throw; force admin cleanup (do not silently pick one) |
| PE in Draft (docstatus=0) | treated as no PE |
| Student moves division mid-year | existing entries keep old PE (historical); new entries get new PE |
| AY rollover | each season's entries link that year's PE |
| Duplicate (game\_authority, student, name\_of\_game, AY) | name-uniqueness rejects; clear error |
| Submit after end\_date | V7 throws; window closed |
| age\_group not allowed for the game | V3 throws |
| event not allowed for the game | V4 throws |
| age-as-on-31-Dec mismatch vs band | V5 (see OQ — strict reject vs warn) |
| One game in a multi-game submit fails | whole submission rolled back (atomic fan-out) |
| Payment fails / abandoned | entries remain payment\_status=Pending; not Selected-eligible until Paid (policy — see OQ) |
| Guessed/leaked form\_hash | permission\_query\_conditions still blocks other families' data |
| Game Authority Cancelled after submissions | entries flagged; parents notified; selection halted |

# **13\. Permissions & Roles**

***Table 13.1: Permission matrix***

| DocType | Guardian | Sport Coordinator | Sport Admin |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Game Organiser / Age / Game Events / Games | — | Read | All |
| Game Authority | Read (Published) | Read/Write | All \+ Submit/Cancel |
| Game Entry | Own children only (create via Web Form; no edit after submit) | Read all; write selection\_\* only | All |
| Game Entry Details | Own children only | Read all | All |

• Guardian scope enforced via permission\_query\_conditions on Game Entry (student linked to guardian via Guardian Student).

• All changes auto-logged via track\_changes=1 (Frappe Version) — no custom log doctype.

| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| NFR-1 | Performance | Web Form initial render ≤ 1.5s on 4G; cascade dropdown refresh ≤ 300ms |

| NFR-3 | Scalability | 5,000 concurrent submissions during deadline spike |
| NFR-4 | Scalability | ≥ 50,000 Game Entry rows per AY |
| NFR-5 | Security | Reuse Walnut auth; zero client-trust; server re-validation of full cascade |
| NFR-6 | Auditability | Every state change captured in Frappe Version \+ docstatus |
| NFR-7 | Availability | ≥ 99.5% during registration windows |
| NFR-8 | Maintainability | New organiser/season \= data only; no deploy |
| NFR-9 | Compliance | Minor-data handling per existing edu\_quality policy; consent captured |
| NFR-10 | Recoverability | Covered by Frappe nightly backups; RPO ≤ 24h |

# **20\. Revision — Game Authority Enhancements (15 May 2026)**

*This section supersedes §5.7 and amends §5.11, §6.4 and §7.4. Decisions taken with the requester on 15 May 2026, modelled on the live `Event` doctype (Frappe core + `edu_quality` customizations).*

> **Build status (15 May 2026): ARCHITECTURE-ONLY.** Per requester direction the app currently ships **DocType JSON + bare scaffolding only** — every controller is `class X(Document): pass`, `.js` files are empty stubs, `.py` test files are `pass`, and **no** logic modules exist (no GCal wrappers, no reminder task, no image API; `hooks.py` `doc_events`/`scheduler_events` left commented). `required_apps` is kept (it is architectural). §20.3–20.6 below are the **agreed design spec for the implementation pass**, not yet code. The data model (§20.1–20.2) is fully built and migratable.

## **20.1 Data model now 12 doctypes (was 10)**

Two child doctypes added, both **owned by `unity_games`** (standalone-app principle — no coupling to the `edu_quality` Event customization):

* **Game Authority Image** (Child of Game Authority) — gallery, modelled on `edu_quality`'s `Event Gallery Image`.
* **Game Authority Class** (Child of Game Authority) — eligible classes/divisions, modelled on `edu_quality`'s `Event Class`.

***Table 20.1: Game Authority Image (Child of Game Authority)***

| Publish | publish | Check | No | default 0 |
| Publish Date | publish\_date | Datetime | No | hidden, RO; stamped on first publish |

***Table 20.2: Game Authority Class (Child of Game Authority)***

| Field | Fieldname | Type | Req | Notes |

## **20.2 Game Authority — new fields (supersedes Table 5.7)**

Organised into tabs: **Details / Gallery / Google Calendar / Rules & Limitations**.

| Field | Fieldname | Type | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Branch | branch | Link → Branch | Scope: which branch/school this season runs for |
| Location | location | Link → Address | Venue |
| Holiday | holiday | Check | General-holiday marker; morning reminder skips these |
| Send an email reminder in the morning | send\_reminder | Check | default 1; drives the custom daily task (§20.4) |
| All Day | all\_day | Check | default 1; treats dates as all-day for Google Calendar |
| Background Image | background\_image | Attach Image | Gallery tab |
| 📷 Upload Images | upload\_images\_btn | Button | Gallery tab; FileUploader → API (§20.3) |
| Gallery Status | gallery\_status | HTML | Gallery tab; count summary |
| Gallery Images | images | Table → Game Authority Image | Gallery tab |
| Sync with Google Calendar | sync\_with\_google\_calendar | Check | GCal tab |
| Add Video Conferencing | add\_video\_conferencing | Check | via Google Meet |
| Google Calendar | google\_calendar | Link → Google Calendar | mandatory when sync on |
| Google Calendar ID | google\_calendar\_id | Data | RO, fetch\_from google\_calendar |
| Google Calendar Event ID | google\_calendar\_event\_id | Data | RO, no\_copy |
| Google Meet Link | google\_meet\_link | Small Text | RO, no\_copy |
| Pulled from Google Calendar | pulled\_from\_google\_calendar | Check | RO |
| All Classes | all\_classes | Check | Rules tab; auto-fills classes table |
| Classes | classes | Table → Game Authority Class | Rules tab |

Status transition guard added (PRD Q8): **Draft → Published → Closed/Cancelled** only, enforced in `Game Authority.validate()`. `all_classes` auto-fills `classes` with the branch's Programs. Gallery `publish_date` is stamped on first publish.

**Game Entry:** a read-only `branch` (Link → Branch) field is added, auto-resolved server-side from the selected student in `resolve_pe()` (the student→branch source field is an Open Question). *Branch auto-from-student belongs on Game Entry, not Game Authority — Game Authority's `branch` is a season scope field.*

## **20.3 "Upload Images" gallery (simple)**

Decision: **simple gallery** — no native-camera / publish-notification pipeline (unlike `edu_quality`).

* `Game Authority` form button **📷 Upload Images** (`game_authority.js`) opens Frappe's `frappe.ui.FileUploader` (multi-file, images only).
* On complete it calls `unity_games.api.game_authority_image_handler.add_gallery_images(game_authority, file_urls)`, which appends rows to `images` and saves.
* `get_gallery_images()` powers the Gallery Status summary.

## **20.4 Morning email reminder (custom daily task)**

Frappe core's `send_event_digest` is **hardcoded to the `Event` table** (queries `` `tabEvent` `` WHERE `send_reminder=1`) and emails per-user digests to system users who enabled "Event Reminders" — it **cannot** serve Game Authority. A custom task replaces it:

* `unity_games.tasks.send_game_authority_reminders`, wired to a **daily 6 AM cron** in `hooks.py` `scheduler_events`.
* Selects Published + enabled, **non-Holiday**, submitted Game Authorities whose window **opens today / closes today / closes tomorrow**.
* **Recipients (decision: both):** (a) coordinator/Sport-Admin operational digest; (b) guardian registration reminders with their auto-login link (uses `Guardian.form_hash` from the auth pass; degrades gracefully until that custom field exists).

## **20.5 Google Calendar sync (push-only)**

Decision: **push-only custom wrappers**. Stock hooks `frappe.integrations…google_calendar.{insert,update,delete}_event_in_google_calendar` hardcode `frappe.db.set_value("Event", …)` on write-back, so they cannot target Game Authority.

* New module `unity_games.integrations.google_calendar` replicates insert/update/delete, **reusing** Frappe's helpers (`get_google_calendar_object`, `format_date_according_to_google_calendar`, `get_conference_data`) but writing back to **Game Authority**.
* Field mapping: `title`→summary, `description`→description, `start_date`/`end_date`→event start/end (all-day by default).
* Wired in `hooks.py` `doc_events["Game Authority"]`: `after_insert` / `on_update` / `on_trash`.
* Pull-back (Google → Frappe) is **out of scope for V1** (the core pull path is heavily Event-coupled). The global `…google_calendar.sync` scheduler is unaffected.

## **20.6 doc_events / scheduler additions (amends Table 6.2)**

| DocType / Schedule | Event | Handler |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Game Authority | after\_insert | unity\_games.integrations.google\_calendar.insert\_event\_in\_google\_calendar |
| Game Authority | on\_update | unity\_games.integrations.google\_calendar.update\_event\_in\_google\_calendar |
| Game Authority | on\_trash | unity\_games.integrations.google\_calendar.delete\_event\_from\_google\_calendar |
| cron `0 6 * * *` | daily | unity\_games.tasks.send\_game\_authority\_reminders |

## **20.8 Unity Games Settings (Single) — resolves Q6**

A Single doctype for app-wide config, replacing per-record repetition and hardcoded policy. Built now as **architecture-only** (bare controller). Makes the model **13 DocTypes**. Permissions: System Manager (the RPA section is sensitive — `rpa_password` is a `Password` field, encrypted at rest; a Sport Admin role restriction will be added with the roles in the implementation pass).

***Table 20.3: Unity Games Settings sections***

| Section | Fields |
| :---- | :---- |
| Google Calendar | default\_google\_calendar (Link → Google Calendar) — seasons inherit; Game Authority.google\_calendar overrides |
| Reminders | enable\_morning\_reminder, notify\_coordinators, notify\_guardians, reminder\_days\_before\_close, coordinator\_roles, reminder\_sender (Link → Email Account) — drives the §20.4 task |
| Consent | consent\_text (Text Editor) — shown on the web form (V9) |
| External Portal (RPA) | rpa\_enabled, cbse\_portal\_url, rpa\_username, rpa\_password (Password, encrypted) — **resolves Open Question Q6** |
| Late Fee | late\_fee\_enabled, late\_fee\_amount, late\_fee\_after\_date — placeholder for the deferred Q4 feature |

**Explicitly NOT in Settings** (already handled elsewhere): payment gateway/currency (owned by the `payments` app — PRD §9); Academic Year default (Frappe global default, PRD §6.2); `form_hash` length and web-form route (fixed constants). **Q6 status: RESOLVED** — implemented as the External Portal section of this Single doctype.
